Sparse Diagonal Matrix

Source: R/utils_safe.R
sparse_diag.Rd

Creates diagonal matrix using sparse format for large dimensions

Usage

sparse_diag(x, sparse_threshold = 100)

Arguments

x

Diagonal values or dimension

sparse_threshold

Size threshold for sparse format

Value

Diagonal matrix
